# `network/peerTickets/ReconnectOrder.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/peerTickets/ReconnectOrder.js`

network/peerTickets/ReconnectOrder.js — full device-boot reconnect order (network plan §38): cached peer tickets (freshest first) -> LAN -> group gossip -> master servers -> carrier -> DHT. Ties Phase 5 (peer tickets) onto Phase 2's `buildConnectionOrder` (routes/MasterServerList.js) without modifying it.
